intro: The Encrypted Tablet is a summons delivered by Gornek to aspiring rogues training within the Valley of Trials. Written in cipher, the message directs novice cutpurses to Rwag, the covert operative in the Den who oversees rogue instruction and ties to the Shattered Hand.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, friend.
Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the rogue trainer Rwag. He would have words with you when you're ready.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Welcome to the Valley of Trials, friend. You wouldn't be here if you hadn't gotten my tablet, so I will get to the point.

I am Rwag and I am responsible for training the rogues, thieves, and cutpurses here in the Valley. I'm the one the Hand will turn to if you're not ready for what's to come. But don't worry, the Hand won't be controlling everything you do, but it would be wise to work with them if they have need of your talents.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Until such time comes, you'll be under my tutelage. I will show you the ropes as some folks say. Whenever you feel prepared, come to me and I will see about training you further. Until then, practice your skills and keep them honed to a razor's edge. You'll never know when you'll need even the most insignificant ability.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
